Class Game

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.galaxytruckers.client.model.Game
public class Game extends Object
Represents a game session in the Galaxy Truckers game. This class manages the game state, player ships, flight board, and other components required for gameplay. It's instantiated with a specific flight level, test or level II that determines how the game components are configured.
